{{Recipe}}

This easy recipe for '''pasta''' is designed for children to make and eat. Make sure to supervise children when cooking.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] [[Cookbook:Whole Wheat Flour|whole-wheat]] [[Cookbook:Spaghetti|spaghetti]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], cut into thin strips
* ½ lb [[Cookbook:Green Bean|green beans]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] tomato [[Cookbook:Pasta Sauce|pasta sauce]]

== Procedure ==

# Bring a pot of water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Add spaghetti and carrots to the boiling water, and cook for 4 minutes.
# Add green beans, and cook for another 4 minutes.
# Meanwhile, heat the tomato sauce.
# Drain the spaghetti and the vegetables, then mix it with the heated sauce.
# Add a [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of salt if needed.
# Serve.
